title: Multiplayer Shooter
description: A session-based shooter built with Netcode for GameObjects.
short: A session-based shooter built with Netcode for GameObjects, an authoritative server and client-side prediction.
details: A 4–8 player shooter prototype created to work with Unity networking and explore server-authoritative architecture.
Netcode for GameObjects is used as the foundation, with additional interpolation, reconciliation and client-side prediction systems implemented on top.
The server is authoritative: clients send intents, while the resulting game state is calculated by the server.
Unity Relay was used for test matchmaking, allowing matches to run without a separate dedicated server.
The project remained a prototype and was primarily used for practical work with network ticks, prediction and lag compensation.
